react_native_issues.issue: RefreshControl is not fully supported on react-native-web and in this build appears to collapse the ScrollView content to zero. Suggested fix: pass refreshControl only on native platforms, e.g. `refreshControl={Platform.OS !== 'web' && onRefresh ? <RNRefresh ... /> : undefined}`. Reference: /app/mobile/src/ui.tsx:30-34

rca of the issue: RCA: react-native-web's ScrollView does not reliably support RefreshControl. The Screen helper always attaches `<RefreshControl>` when `onRefresh` is provided, which on the Expo web preview appears to short-circuit rendering of the ScrollView's children (verified: document.querySelectorAll on those screens returns zero data-testid elements, while the identical screens render their header). Fix: guard the refreshControl prop with `Platform.OS !== 'web'`, or render a web-only ScrollView without pull-to-refresh. Reproduction: sign in as admin, open the Deals tab, inspect the DOM — only the header is present, no Card/Button children render. Same reproduction for client Documents and underwriter Deals.
